name: runhand
description: Safe simulation Run staging, no-replace promotion, disposable scratch, and RunHand-owned state maintenance.

interface.shortDescription: Stage and publish simulation Runs safely.
interface.longDescription: Moves simulation work safely from an existing Run into a disposable stage and then into a new no-replace formal Run, or allocates scratch for bounded temporary work. Scientific semantics remain with Simulator capabilities, scheduler semantics remain with Site capabilities, and maintenance cleanup is isolated in a focused companion skill.
defaultPrompt: Create a new simulation run from the nearest precedent.
Run a bounded smoke test using site-safe scratch.
Preview cleanup of old RunHand scratch data.
